pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Healing Slime + bone meal + a nether star. Keeps companion data and starts waiting.

It retains equipment and cargo and carries a golden lyre beside its body. Choose Nurture. It retains healing and revival, prioritizing companions before applying native bonemeal effects to nearby growable crops, saplings, and other plants. Its fixed detection area is twice the common base, initially 16 blocks. Crops and saplings take priority over grass.

Each allowed growth application costs two stamina, uses no bone meal item, and earns one activity. Native chance may leave the plant unchanged. Surrounding terrain must be loaded. Healing still needs slimeballs. Growth respects mobGriefing and protection events; carriers supply slimeballs.
